origin: Real. Install receipt of the Kraken2 viral database 20260626, written by Lungfish 2026.9.1 (4354) on 2026-10-05 and read (read only) from the managed databases folder of the capture Mac. Two edits. The account home folder was replaced by /home/corpus (35 places, all in the escaped-slash spelling), and the two user values, which held the account name, were replaced by lge-user.

Synthetic. The tracked historical fixture backfill of the Kraken2 analysis fixture, written by the fixture provenance script on 2026-05-10 (an envelope without the eight compat keys). Copied byte for byte, no edit.

Real. The bare WorkflowRun that lungfish-cli 0.4.0-alpha.11 fetch ncbi wrote on 2026-05-09 beside MN908947.3.gff3. Tracked at the path in this row and referenced in place, so it is copied to a temporary project (with MN908947.3.gff3) at test time and never duplicated. Its recorded home paths stay as the writer wrote them, which is why the facts rewrite any account folder to <home>.

Real. The sidecar shipped inside the app's MCM-MHC-miSeq-20260617 haplotyping reference bundle, written by its build script on 2026-06-17 (a primitive record with startedAt, inputs and outputs). Copied byte for byte from the release resource at commit 81e89a306, no edit.

Real. The sidecar that align mafft wrote for a MAFFT alignment bundle on 2026-05-03 (a primitive record with files as a map, externalToolInvocations and inputFiles), taken with git show from commit fc3120b07 before the 2026-05-10 backfill script replaced it. One edit, the account home folder was replaced by /home/corpus in the escaped-slash spelling (26 places).

Captured once at 81e89a306 in a temporary .lungfish project by ProvenanceCompatCLICaptureTests. CLIProvenanceSupport.recordSingleStepRun for a run with status cancelled whose only step exited 0, with a peak memory figure. The envelope embeds the run as legacyWorkflowRun, and the word cancelled appears only there and in the top-level status key. Bytes are exactly what the writer produced, no edit. The runtime identity names the test host that ran the capture.
